versions.changelog:
Initial release of logo-designer-generator providing AI-powered multi-page logo design image carousels.

- Generate logo design image carousels using advanced models like Nano Banana, Nano Banana-2, Imagen-2, and more.
- Supports multiple templates and page layouts, tailored for corporate and editorial styles.
- Easy integration with OneKey Agent Gateway, requiring only an access key.
- Customizable design options including asset size, styles, text, and image layers.
- Includes detailed API usage instructions and quick start guide for setup.
